title: Contact & Booking
lead: I primarily offer treatments from my clinic in the centre of Leiden, where my practice is based. Additionally, I have some availability at a clinic in Amsterdam.
pricingItems: Healing Treatment | 60 mins | €50 per session (€40 reduced rate*)
Healing and Counselling | 90 mins | €75 per session (€60 reduced rate*)
pricingReducedNote: * For students and those experiencing financial constraints. Please choose the rate that best reflects your current circumstances.
bookingLeiden: For treatments in Leiden, please contact me via [WhatsApp](whatsapp) or [Email](email) for scheduling and availability.
bookingAmsterdam: For Reiki treatments in Amsterdam, please refer to [The Integration Room](integration-room) clinic's website for their updated pricing and booking.
bookingHomeNote: Under certain circumstances, I may be able to offer treatments in your home. Reach out if this improves your access to care.
faqNote: You can find more information about sessions in the [FAQ](faq).
